meta.name: codebase-visualizer
meta.description: Generate an interactive tree visualization of your codebase. Use when exploring a new repo or understanding project structure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库结构变成可交互的树形图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速了解一个陌生代码库的整体结构
copy.tagline_en: Turn your codebase into an interactive tree visualization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly grasp the structure of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以生成你代码库的交互式树状图，并自动在浏览器中打开。
howto.when: 当你探索新仓库或想了解项目结构时，Claude 会运行可视化脚本。

say.text: 帮我生成这个项目的代码结构图。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本并打开可视化页面。

say.text: 看看这个仓库的目录树。
say.note: Claude 会生成交互式树状图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate an interactive tree visualization of your codebase and open it in your default browser.
howto.when_en: When you are exploring a new repository or want to understand the project structure, Claude will run the visualization script.

say_en.text: Generate a code structure diagram for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will run the script and open the visualization.

say_en.text: Show me the directory tree of this repo.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an interactive tree visualization.
